title: WFP3: graded-confidence recursive filters and a block truncated QFT

claims.statement: For every N>=2 and s modulo N, n=ceil(log2N), the ONE WFP3 physical algorithm in proof.md recovers the ENTIRE s with unconditional success STRICTLY greater than2/3 under the exact fixed original joint-good-marginal model. It acquires exactly the original Q=3*2^40(n+32) registers, with the unchanged full-reference extraction and private split, and touches no retained endpoint row in coarse processing. For n<2^4096 it executes the complete original SPTS-JM noisy-input algorithm. For n>=2^4096 it uses the exact public parameters, label-only collision filter, random integer anchor and constant-term guard, flagged sparse cubic-score starting unitary, ordinary initialized exact-gradient catalyst and truncated pointwise-flat Fourier word, weighted dyadic-class pivots with stopped mass-band hitting proof and hard pre-attempt token cutoff. ALL visited dyadic classes are classically expanded to original integer classes, followed by the original full-shadow champion and original untouched-bank endpoint. The full arbitrary-reference source law, bad/good correlations, all finite branches, sampler/gradient/label/count failures and all additional base events are included without a conditional-fresh-good premise or a per-query approximation hybrid. No QRAM, source inverse/control, supplied purification, free word arithmetic, instruction oracle or arbitrary rotation primitive is used. The actual stored finite Clifford+T words and their actual adjoints are generated and charged, with full combined-memory address fees. ALL FIVE objects hold JOINTLY on EVERY branch for this SAME implementation, including failed/discarded work, original source fees, fixed padding, initialization and complete output-first cleanup. Charged sequential time is O(2^((1/2)n)n(log2n)^(3/2)), exact growth index1. The actual base costs O(nL^2); constraint i costs O((1+log2(i+1))nL^2). The charged three-call recurrence has a convergent weighted overhead sum and costs O(3^j nL^2), and deterministic token Budget is O(2^(n/2)L^(-1/2)) because m=Theta(L) and the proved actual true-class base mass is at least1/D, D=ceil(2^80*2^(n+32)/m). All polynomial source/filter/streamed coefficient angle enumeration, all accepted-pivot caches, classical integer expansion/champion and endpoint/setup/cleanup work are separately charged and absorbed. This is not an expected hitting-work bound or reuse of an old uniform-pivot theorem. The current public configuration uses m=2^100 L, per-constraint ell_i=2^17(32+2ceil(log2(i+1))), recomputed dependent caps and the controlled register-addition block QFT. Complete current proof and exact immediate WFP2 source are included; the graded recursive cost is bounded by a convergent geometric sum, and all survival tails are summed.

structured.error_model: Among the Q acquired copies, an adversary fixes a set B of at most floor(epsilon(n) Q) malformed positions, possibly depending on N and s. The joint state is arbitrary subject to its reduced state on all other positions being exactly rho_s^{tensor (Q-|B|)}. Malformed systems may be correlated or entangled with each other and with other systems subject to that marginal promise. No source control, purification access, or preparation inverse is supplied.
